en: The Path of Discrimination 2:
The Chapter on the Coupling 2.4.
Discourse on Loving-kindness (Mettā)
The setting was at Sāvatthī.

"Bhikkhus, when the liberation of mind through loving-kindness has been cultivated, developed, practiced frequently, made a vehicle, made a foundation, established, consolidated, and properly undertaken, eleven benefits are to be expected.
What are the eleven?
One sleeps happily, wakes up happily, does not see evil dreams, is dear to human beings,
is dear to non-human beings, is protected by deities, fire, poison, or weapons do not affect one, the mind quickly becomes concentrated,
the facial complexion becomes serene, one dies unconfused, and furthermore—
If one does not penetrate further, one goes to the Brahma-world. Monks,
when the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is practiced, developed, cultivated, made a vehicle, made a foundation, established, consolidated, and well-undertaken,
these eleven benefits are to be expected.”

There is the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of non-specific pervasion; there is the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of specific pervasion; there is the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of directional pervasion.

In how many ways is there the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of non-specific pervasion? In how many ways is there the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of specific pervasion? In how many ways is there the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of directional pervasion?

There is the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of non-specific pervasion in five ways; there is the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of specific pervasion in seven ways; there is the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of directional pervasion in ten ways.
In what five ways is there the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of non-specific pervasion?
"May all beings be free from enmity, free from affliction, free from distress, and may they look after themselves happily.
May all living creatures... [and so on].

May all beings... may all persons... may all who are included within the cycle of individual existence be free from enmity, free from affliction, free from distress, and may they maintain themselves in happiness.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of non-specific pervasion is [accomplished] in these five ways.
In what seven ways is the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of specific pervasion [accomplished]?
"May all women be free from enmity, free from affliction, free from distress, and may they maintain themselves in happiness."
All men … [and so on] … all noble ones … [and so on] … all ignoble ones … [and so on].
May all devas...
may all humans...
may all beings in the lower realms be free from enmity, free from affliction, free from distress, and may they maintain themselves in happiness.
These seven modes constitute the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of specific pervasion.
What are the ten modes of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by way of directional pervasion?
May all beings in the eastern direction be free from enmity, free from affliction, free from distress, and may they dwell in happiness, preserving themselves.
May all beings in the western direction …pe… may all beings in the northern direction …pe… may all beings in the southern direction …pe…
May all beings in the eastern intermediate direction …pe… may all beings in the western intermediate direction …pe… may all beings in the northern intermediate direction …pe…

May all beings in the southern intermediate direction … may all beings in the lower direction … may all beings in the upper direction be free from enmity, free from affliction, free from distress, and may they dwell happily, sustaining themselves with well-being.
May all living beings in the eastern direction …pe… all creatures … all persons … [and so on for all directions].
...all those included within the personal existence ...
all women ...
all men ...
all noble ones … all non-noble ones … all devas …
May all human beings … may all those in the states of deprivation be free from enmity, free from affliction, free from distress, and maintain themselves in happiness.
May all those in the states of deprivation in the western direction … [and so on].

All those fallen into the states of misery in the northern direction… all those fallen into the states of misery in the southern direction… all those fallen into the states of misery in the northeastern intermediate direction…
May all those fallen into the intermediate direction of the west...
may all those fallen into the intermediate direction of the north...
may all those fallen into the intermediate direction of the south...
"May all those in the downward direction who are in the states of woe...
may all those in the upward direction who are in the states of woe be free from enmity, free from ill will, free from distress, and may they maintain themselves in happiness.
This is the liberation of mind through loving-kindness by pervading the directions in these ten ways.
2.4.1. Chapter on the Faculties (Indriyavāra) By avoiding oppression for all beings through non-oppression; by avoiding injury through non-injury;
by avoiding torment through non-torment; by avoiding exhaustion through non-exhaustion; and by avoiding affliction through non-affliction.

"May all beings be free from enmity, may they not be hostile; may they be happy, may they not suffer; may they have hearts full of happiness, may they not have hearts full of suffering"—thus, one who exercises loving-kindness toward all beings in these eight ways is "loving-kindness" (*mettā*).
One who wills that state is "mind" (*ceto*).
It is liberated from all obsessions of ill will; thus it is "liberation.
Loving-kindness and mental liberation are "loving-kindness-mental-liberation" (*mettā-cetovimutti*). [The thought:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
One resolves with faith.
Loving-kindness as liberation of mind is permeated by the faculty of faith:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."

One establishes mindfulness.
Loving-kindness as liberation of mind is suffused by the faculty of mindfulness.
Thinking, "May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"—
One concentrates the mind.
Loving-kindness as liberation of the mind becomes fully developed through the faculty of concentration. [Thinking:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
One understands with wisdom.
Loving-kindness liberation of mind is fully developed by the faculty of wisdom.
These five faculties are the cultivation for loving-kindness liberation of mind.
By means of these five faculties, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is practiced.
These five faculties are the development of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these five faculties, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated.
These five faculties are cultivated through the liberation of mind by loving-kindness.
By means of these five faculties, the liberation of mind by loving-kindness is cultivated.
These five faculties are the adornments of the liberation of mind by loving-kindness.
By means of these five faculties, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is well-adorned.
These five faculties are the requisites for the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these five faculties, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is well-equipped.
These five faculties are the attendants of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these five faculties, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is well-attended.
These five faculties are the cultivation, the development, and the frequent practice of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
They are ornaments; they are requisites; they are attendants; they are fulfillments;
they are concomitants; they are co-nascent; they are associated; they are conjoined; they are leaps forward; they are confidences;
they are steadying points; they are liberations; they are contacts through the thought, "This is peace"; they are made a vehicle.

They have become established, they have been made a foundation, they have been undertaken, they have been accumulated, they have been well-commenced, they have been well-developed, they have been well-resolved upon, they have been well-exerted, they have been well-liberated; they produce, they illuminate, and they radiate.
2.4.2. The Chapter on Powers (*Balavāra*).
Thinking, "May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy," one does not waver in the absence of faith; thus,
the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fortified by the power of faith.
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"— thus one does not waver in indolence.
This liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the power of energy.
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"—
thus one is unshakable by negligence.
This liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the power of mindfulness.
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"— thus one does not waver due to restlessness.
This liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the power of concentration.
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"— thus one does not waver because of ignorance.
This liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by the power of wisdom.
These five powers are the cultivation of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these five powers, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated.
These five powers are the development of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By these five powers, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is developed.
These five powers are cultivated by means of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By these five powers, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is brought to abundance.
These five powers are the ornaments of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these five powers, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is well-adorned.
These five powers are the requisites for the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By these five powers, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is well-guarded.
These five powers are the attendants of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By these five powers, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is well-attended.
These five powers are the cultivation of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness; they are its development,
its frequent practice, its adornment, its equipment, its retinue, its fulfillment, its concomitants,
its co-nascents, its associations, its conjunctions, its leaps forward, and its confidences.
They become established, they become steadfast, they become liberated; they become the touching of "this is peace";
they are made a vehicle, made a foundation, undertaken, accumulated, well-undertaken, well-developed, well-resolved, well-emerged, and well-liberated; they produce, illuminate, and radiate.
2.4.3. Chapter on the Factors of Enlightenment:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"—thus one establishes mindfulness.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by the enlightenment factor of mindfulness.
One discerns with wisdom: "May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena.
One exerts energy, thinking: "May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by the enlightenment factor of energy. By thinking,
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be safe,
may they be happy," one allays feverish distress.
Loving-kindness as liberation of mind is suffused with the enlightenment factor of rapture.
With the thought, "May all beings be free from enmity, may they be safe, may they be happy," one pacifies coarseness.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by the enlightenment factor of tranquility.
One concentrates the mind, thinking: "May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by the enlightenment factor of concentration. Thinking,
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be safe, may they be happy," one examines the defilements with wisdom.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
These seven factors of enlightenment are the cultivation of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness;
by means of these seven factors of enlightenment, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated.
These seven factors of enlightenment are the development of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these seven factors of enlightenment, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is developed.
These seven factors of enlightenment are practiced extensively for the sake of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these seven factors of enlightenment, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated.
These seven factors of enlightenment are the ornaments of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these seven factors of enlightenment, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness becomes well-adorned.
These seven factors of enlightenment are the requisites for the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these seven factors of enlightenment, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is well-requisite.
These seven factors of enlightenment are the attendants of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
Liberation of mind through loving-kindness is well-encompassed by these seven factors of enlightenment.
These seven factors of enlightenment are the cultivation, the development, the frequent practice, the adornment,
the equipment, the retinue, the fulfillment, and the accompaniment of liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
They are co-nascent, conjoined, associated, leaping forward, placing confidence,
establishing, liberating, contacting [the thought] "this is peace," made a vehicle,
made a foundation, undertaken, accumulated, well-undertaken, and well-developed.
They become well-established, well-arisen, well-liberated, and they produce, illuminate, and radiate [light].
2.4.4. Chapter on the Factors of the Path:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
He sees rightly.
Loving-kindness as liberation of mind is suffused with right view:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
One directs it rightly.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by right intention:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be safe, may they be happy."
One grasps it rightly.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with right speech:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
He arouses it rightly.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with right action.
Thinking, "May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"—
It purifies it thoroughly.
Loving-kindness liberation of mind is suffused with right livelihood.
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"—thus [it is cultivated].
He exerts himself rightly.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by right effort:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
He establishes it rightly.
Loving-kindness as liberation of mind is fully developed by right mindfulness. [Thinking:
"May all beings be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
One rightly concentrates.
Loving-kindness liberation of mind is fully developed by right concentration.

They are ornaments; they are requisites; they are attendants; they are fulfillments;
they are co-existent; they are conascent; they are associated; they are conjoined; they are leaping forward;
they are confidence; they are steadiness; they are liberation; they are the contact of "this is peace"; they are made into a vehicle.

They have been established, they have been made a foundation, they have been undertaken, they have been accumulated, they have been well-commenced, they have been well-developed, they have been well-resolved, they have been well-exerted, they have been well-liberated; they produce, they illuminate, and they radiate for all living beings... Having avoided the oppression of all those in the states of deprivation, may they be free from oppression; having avoided injury, may they be free from injury; having avoided torment, may they be free from torment;
having avoided exhaustion, may they be free from exhaustion; having avoided affliction, may they be free from affliction.
May all those in the states of deprivation be without enmity and not hostile; may they be happy and not suffering. Because they are happy—
"May they be free from suffering"—through these eight modes one exercises loving-kindness toward all those in the states of deprivation; thus it is *mettā*.
One wills that state; thus it is *ceto*.
It is liberated from all obsessions of ill will, thus it is liberation (*vimutti*).
Loving-kindness and mental liberation are "loving-kindness-mental-liberation" (*mettā-cetovimutti*). [Thinking:
"May all those in the lower realms be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
One resolves with faith.
Loving-kindness as liberation of mind is permeated by the faculty of faith … [as before] … they cause it to arise,
they cause it to shine, they cause it to blaze.
Of all beings in the eastern direction … [and so on] … of all beings in the western direction … of all beings in the northern direction …
... for all beings in the southern direction ...
for all beings in the southeastern intermediate direction ... for all beings in the southwestern intermediate direction ...
[and so on for the western, northwestern, northern, northeastern, downward, and upward directions].
...of all beings in the northern intermediate direction ...
of all beings in the southern intermediate direction ...
of all beings in the nadir direction ...
Having avoided harming all beings in the upward direction, through non-harming;
having avoided injury, through non-injury; having avoided affliction, through non-affliction; having avoided exhaustion, through non-exhaustion;
having avoided violence, through non-violence—may all beings in the upward direction be free from enmity, not hostile, and happy.
"May they be free from suffering; may they be happy, not suffering"—with these eight modes, one radiates loving-kindness toward all beings in the upper direction:
this is *mettā*. One wills that state: this is *ceto*.
It is liberated from all obsessions of ill will; thus it is liberation (*vimutti*).
Loving-kindness and mental liberation; thus it is "liberation of mind through loving-kindness" (*mettā-cetovimutti*).
[Thinking: "May all beings in the upward direction be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy."
One resolves with faith.
Loving-kindness as liberation of mind is permeated by the faculty of faith … [and so on] … they produce it,
illuminate it, and radiate its splendor.
Of all beings in the eastern direction—[and so on]...
of creatures...

Having avoided the oppression of all those in the lower realms, by means of non-oppression;
having avoided injury to all those in the upper realms, by means of non-injury;
having avoided torment, by means of non-torment; having avoided exhaustion, by means of non-exhaustion; [having avoided] violence...
Having abandoned harmfulness, with regard to all those in the upper direction who are in the states of deprivation: "May they be free from enmity, not hostile; may they be happy, not suffering;

may they have a state of happiness, not a state of suffering"—thus, by means of these eight modes, one dwells in loving-kindness toward all those in the upper direction who are in the states of deprivation: this is loving-kindness (*mettā*).
It intends that state, thus it is "mind" (*ceto*).
It is liberated from all obsessions of ill will, thus it is "liberation" (*vimutti*).
Loving-kindness and mind-liberation are "loving-kindness mind-liberation" (*mettā-cetovimutti*).
"May all those in the upper direction who have fallen into the lower realms be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"—
thus one resolves with faith.
This liberation of mind through loving-kindness is permeated by the faculty of faith.
"May all those in the upper direction who have fallen into the lower realms be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"—
thus one exerts energy.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused by the faculty of energy.
He establishes mindfulness.
Loving-kindness as liberation of mind is permeated by the faculty of mindfulness.
He concentrates the mind.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by the faculty of concentration;
one understands it with wisdom.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is fully developed by the faculty of wisdom.
These five faculties are the cultivation of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these five faculties, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated … [as before] … they bring it forth,
illuminate it, and cause it to blaze.
"May all those in the upper direction who have fallen into the lower realms be free from enmity, safe, and happy"—thus, it does not waver in the face of lack of faith;
this liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the power of faith.
It does not waver in the face of laziness; this liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the power of energy.
It does not waver in negligence; the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the power of mindfulness.
It does not waver in restlessness; the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the power of concentration.
It does not waver in ignorance; the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the power of wisdom.
These five powers are the cultivation of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these five powers, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated … [as before] … they bring it forth,
illuminate it, and make it radiant.
"May all those who have fallen into the lower realms in the upward direction be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"—
thus one establishes mindfulness.
This liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the enlightenment factor of mindfulness.
One discriminates with wisdom; thus the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated by the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena.
One exerts energy; thus the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated by the enlightenment factor of energy.
One allays feverish distress; thus the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated by the enlightenment factor of rapture.
When one allays what is gross, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the enlightenment factor of tranquility.
When one concentrates the mind, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the enlightenment factor of concentration.
When one reflects upon defilements with wisdom, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused with the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
These seven factors of enlightenment are the cultivation of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
By means of these seven factors of enlightenment, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated … [and so on] … they bring it forth,
they illuminate it, they make it radiant.
"May all those in the upper direction who are in the states of deprivation be free from enmity, may they be secure, may they be happy"—thus one sees rightly;
loving liberation of mind is cultivated by right view.
One directs [the mind] rightly; loving liberation of mind is cultivated by right intention.
One grasps it rightly; thus the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused by right speech.
One causes it to arise rightly; thus the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused by right action.
One purifies it rightly; thus the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused by right livelihood.
One exerts correctly; thus the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused by right effort.
One establishes oneself correctly; thus the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused by right mindfulness.
One concentrates correctly; thus the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is suffused by right concentration.
These eight path factors are the cultivation of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.

By means of these eight path factors, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness is cultivated … [as before] … These eight path factors are fully developed by the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
The liberation of mind through loving-kindness is well-enveloped by these eight factors of the path.
These eight factors of the path are the cultivation, the development, the frequent practice, the adornment,
the equipment, the retinue, the fulfillment, and the accompaniment of the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.
They are co-nascent, conjoined, associated, leaping forward, placing confidence,
establishing, liberating, touching [the realization] that "this is peace," made a vehicle,
made a foundation, undertaken, accumulated, well-undertaken, and well-developed.
They are well-established, well-arisen, and well-liberated; they produce, illuminate, and pervade.
The Discourse on Loving-kindness is finished.
